non-tonal.label: Non-tonal
non-tonal.description: Pitch changes don't affect word meaning.

pitch-accent.label: Pitch-accent
pitch-accent.description: It uses pitch accent, where certain syllables are emphasized with pitch changes.

simple-tonal.label: Simple tonal
simple-tonal.description: Pitch changes moderately affect word meaning.

complex-tonal.label: Complex tonal
complex-tonal.description: Pitch patterns significantly affect word meaning.

isolating.label: Isolating
isolating.description: Words typically consist of single morphemes and don't change their form. Grammar is expressed through word order and separate function words rather than endings or prefixes.

agglutinative.label: Agglutinative
agglutinative.description: Words are built by stacking affixes one after another, where each affix carries exactly one meaning. The pieces stay clearly recognizable, like building blocks snapped together.

introflexive.label: Introflexive
introflexive.description: Grammar is built into the word from the inside: a root of consonants carries the core meaning, while different vowel patterns woven through it create new words. For example, the Arabic root k-t-b relates to writing, and kataba, kitāb, and kātib all come from it.

fusional.label: Fusional
fusional.description: Words change their form through endings and prefixes that bundle multiple grammatical meanings at once. A single ending might express gender, number, and case simultaneously, making the pieces hard to pull apart.

polysynthetic.label: Polysynthetic
polysynthetic.description: A single word can express what other languages would say in a whole sentence, by fusing the verb, subject, object, and other elements together. Common in indigenous languages of the Americas and the Arctic.

semi-flexible.label: Semi-flexible
semi-flexible.description: Some variation of word order is allowed for emphasis.

flexible.label: Flexible
flexible.description: Various word arrangements are allowed for stylistic purposes.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.description: No or very limited grammatical aspect marking.

complex.label: Complex
complex.description: Multiple aspect categories with rich morphological marking.

none.label: None
none.description: No grammatical marking of information source.

optional.label: Optional
optional.description: Evidential-like markers exist but are not obligatory.

complex.label: Complex
complex.description: Four or more evidential distinctions or evidentiality fused with tense/aspect.

maxConsonantClusterSize.name: Max consonants in a cluster
maxConsonantClusterSize.template: It can have maximally {count} consonants together in one cluster.
